emulatorAcceptance.environment: Android 36 emulator instance with read-only source AVD overlays
newCases: one-time system-picker creation with default filename and persistent read/write grant
a second backup without opening a picker
fresh connection to an existing managed backup history
coordinator recreation using persisted settings and grants
in-app selection and restore of an older snapshot into a fresh database
older JSON import when the provider reports an unexpected MIME type

providerFailureCoverage: truncated writes and rollback to previous verified history
revoked read access with labeled local recovery
invalid history cannot replace a working connection
disconnect revokes persistent permission without deleting cloud or library data
bounded history retention, hashes and unsafe archive entries
scope: Synthetic provider validates Android file-picker and grant behavior. It does not certify the current Google Drive provider's persistent-access or cloud-sync behavior.
